# arke_opentelemetry_ex v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

All-in-one OpenTelemetry setup for Elixir applications. Bundles tracing (Phoenix, Cowboy, Ecto) and OTLP log export into a single dependency.

## Modules

- [ArkeOpentelemetryEx](https://arke-opentelemetry-ex.hexdocs.pm/ArkeOpentelemetryEx.md): All-in-one OpenTelemetry setup for Elixir applications.
- [ArkeOpentelemetryEx.Exporter](https://arke-opentelemetry-ex.hexdocs.pm/ArkeOpentelemetryEx.Exporter.md)
- [ArkeOpentelemetryEx.LogRecord](https://arke-opentelemetry-ex.hexdocs.pm/ArkeOpentelemetryEx.LogRecord.md)
- [ArkeOpentelemetryEx.LoggerBackend](https://arke-opentelemetry-ex.hexdocs.pm/ArkeOpentelemetryEx.LoggerBackend.md)
